[1/1] Streaming float32 WAV export writer

impact_assessment.why: Reforge run-8 stage-35 finding: export accumulates the whole render in a Python list plus np.concatenate, ~2x peak memory (up to ~2.5 GB at the 60-min clamp)
impact_assessment.benefits: O(1) export memory bounded to one generator block; no concatenate pause; same float32 WAV format and fade behavior
impact_assessment.risks: contract: _run_export_thread signature unchanged, tests patch new _StreamingWavWriter seam; dependency: stdlib struct only; concurrency: writer used solely by the export thread, cancel/error paths close and unlink partial file; state: partial file removed on cancel/error so cancelled export still writes nothing
impact_assessment.mitigation: failure-first regression test reads the exported file back with scipy and compares to reference generator blocks; full project suite plus aikit check --strict before commit
